subject: Renewal + Portfolio Expansion: ClearHarbor staged projects & terms
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearharbor.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion planning — ClearHarbor portfolio

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. Our account renewal window is coming up (Dec 5), and this cycle we want to both renew our core contract and add four new project teams that will be shipping in H1 next year. High level: two new mobile apps (search and customer support), one analytics pipeline, and a sandbox integration namespace for partners.

Key asks:
- Rough cost/term impact for adding 4 additional API key namespaces and a ~25% increase in token consumption (projected).
- A staged rollout plan: we’d like to enable one project per month over a 4-month period starting mid-Jan.
- Any recommended guardrails for key segregation and rate limits per project.

Can we get a proposed mutual action plan and a ballpark addendum for the renewal (we prefer a 12-month term with an expansion clause)? I’d like to get commercial terms in place before our internal procurement cycle begins Nov 10.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Head of Platform, ClearHarbor Technologies
M: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: none
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-22T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion planning — ClearHarbor portfolio

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear outline. This is a perfect candidate for a staged addendum + MAP so procurement has visibility on timing and milestones.

Quick answers:
- We can structure a 12-month renewal with a defined expansion commitment window (option to add up to N namespaces during the term at a blended rate).
- Preliminary cost impact for a 25% token increase + 4 namespaces looks like ~18% ARR uplift (ballpark) — I’ll get a formal number from pricing.
- For rollout, we recommend namespace-per-project, per-namespace rate limits, and an initial sandbox environment that’s rate-limited more aggressively.

I’m attaching a draft MAP and a pricing addendum (worksheet) — Ben, can you review the capacity/namespace plan? Laura, please flag any provisioning lead times we need to communicate.

Propose a 30-minute sync next week (Nov 1) to walk the MAP and confirm procurement milestones.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Lead — Redwood Inference
Priya.natarajan@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-10-24T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ClearHarbor expansion — capacity notes and provisioning checklist

Priya / Laura / Evelyn —

I ran a quick capacity model with the SE team based on the 25% token bump + 4 namespaces. Notes:
- Recommend Dedicated pool scaling: reserve an extra 1.5x baseline GPU capacity during the 4-month ramp (Jan-Apr) to preserve latency SLOs while they onboard.
- Namespace strategy: create 5 namespaces (4 projects + 1 partner sandbox). Each namespace gets a separate API key and default rate policy.
- KV cache: we should enable prefix caching for the two mobile apps to cut token spend by ~12%.
- Provisioning lead time: 7 business days per namespace for production keys once we have the signed addendum and PoC completion.

Action items:
1) Laura: confirm provisioning slot availability for Jan 15 start.
2) Evelyn: prepare a config template for namespace RBAC and default rate limits.
3) Priya: confirm whether they want a canary pattern (we can gate the second project until the first reaches 95% success threshold).

-- Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

Subject: Proposal: MAP + addendum for renewal and staged expansion

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the discussion last week. Please find the attached MAP (v2) and the pricing addendum worksheet. Highlights:
- Term: 12 months starting Dec 5, 2028.
- Expansion: up to 4 additional project namespaces to be activated during the term; each activation has a 7-business-day production provisioning SLA after DocuSign countersign and PoC sign-off.
- Financials: blended uplift estimate ~18% ARR; see pricing-addendum_4821.xlsx for line items and per-namespace rates.
- Rollout cadence: month-by-month activation; we recommend a canary threshold before moving to the next project.

Next steps:
1) Review the MAP and addendum and send any commercial redlines by Nov 3.
2) If green, I’ll send the DocuSign envelope for signature and schedule provisioning slots (we have a Jan 15 pilot slot available).
3) Ben will follow up on technical onboarding and the per-namespace rate limits.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CHB-4821

Best regards,

Thanks — overall this looks good. Quick counterpoints from procurement & infra:

I’ve attached a short redline with suggested language (ClearHarbor_counterterms.pdf). If you can accept those items we can sign quickly.
